scope: Post hoc motion review prompted by user clarification. No human naturalness metric, no pass/fail by goal success, no new model calls.
criteria: Unmet goal or skipping an available correct control is not by itself abnormal.
Revisiting after exploring other plausible places may be reasonable.
Separate raw model choice, policy-modified choice and actual UI execution.
Repeated visible route patterns are observations, not proof of implausible behavior.
Check available history and new information before inferring forgetting.

limitations: No participant comparison or persona-specific plausibility validation.
The observational criteria were defined after viewing the earlier experimental results.
A local raw-choice counterfactual cannot establish an alternative full trajectory.
Audit labels/counters are used offline and are not additional actor inputs.
No movement is labeled wrong merely for not choosing the goal-achieving path.

semantics.images: Attached input PNG is primary perceptual evidence. Only six were visually inspected; all 88 current file hashes were checked. Equal input PNG hashes establish equal delivered pixels, not equal hidden state or actor cognition.
semantics.audit: DOM text/hidden fixture state are reviewer evidence only; not treated as actor knowledge.
semantics.model: Native extraction, quoted text, assessments and working conditions are fallible model output. ModelChoice is distinct from final selected action after shared weights.
semantics.memory: Actual modelInput and imageAssets inspected; image memory capacity 3 is not the only memory channel.

assessment.goalRanking: Goal attainment does not rank behavior naturalness; previous adoption rationale based on 3/4 versus1/4 is withdrawn.
assessment.selectionOverrides: Seven observed changes, not seven automatic behavioral defects.
assessment.loopInterpretation: Four account exits are policy-induced; one alternating tail is model-origin. Full unweighted trajectories are not inferred.
assessment.revisits: Revisiting after alternative routes disappoint is a plausible hypothesis, not a defect by itself.
assessment.memory: 72 prior outcome carry opportunities verified. Receipt pixels can be absent while semantic/event recollections remain; forgetting is not established.
